content.value_statement: Turning articles into clear animated explanations requires coordinated narration, visuals, and timing. This skill plans scenes and renders hand-drawn videos around a verified continuous narration track.
actual_capabilities: Plan audience-focused narratives, storyboards, illustration briefs, and ordered drawing regions from topics, articles, or scripts.
Use configured local VoiceStudio or VoxCPM2 narration, or reuse approved recordings with verified timestamps.
Animate separate character strokes and illustration outlines before ordered color filling, synchronized to narration.
Offer drawing styles, six arm presets, a pen-only mode, six voice labels, optional pen text, watermarks, and subtitle settings.
Render videos locally with FFmpeg and deliver covers, scripts, editing subtitles, and verification records.
Validate asset hashes, drawing order, subtitle uniqueness, narration preservation, and review records before final delivery.
limitations: New images require an available image tool, Bun, and ExifTool; rendering requires Python dependencies, FFmpeg, and suitable fonts.
New narration requires configured local speech services; original-recording voice presets need private references imported locally.
Initial public asset downloads require network access; offline operation needs valid cached assets and prepared inputs.
Glyph tracing does not guarantee calligraphic stroke order; visual meaning and subjective audio quality still require direct review.

faq.question: What should I provide to start?
faq.answer: Provide a topic, story, article, script, attachment, or readable source. Audience and style preferences are optional.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The package targets Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Actual production also depends on available image tools and local rendering dependencies.

faq.question: Can it run offline?
faq.answer: Local rendering can reuse prepared images, approved narration, timestamps, and verified cached presets. Missing hosted assets require an initial download.

faq.question: Does it install speech models or buy services?
faq.answer: No. It uses already configured local VoiceStudio or VoxCPM2, or approved existing audio, and reports missing capabilities.

faq.question: Does it add music or publish the video?
faq.answer: Background music is disabled by default. The skill does not publish videos or create service accounts.

faq.question: Are automated checks enough for approval?
faq.answer: No. Structural checks support production review, but visual meaning, motion quality, and subjective voice quality need direct inspection.
